conditioningLevel.rationale: High conditioning potential is supported by a clear fatty-alcohol/long-chain quat base plus an early ester and an oil cluster, with a separate hydrolyzed keratin film candidate.
conditioningLevel.derivation: R1 and R4 converge on higher M1 conditioning; M2 recorded separately, not multiplied into several endpoint scores.
thresholdReasoning: Moderate is a credible neighboring result if actual actives are low, but early cationic base and ester with the oil payload favor high potential.
High is a formula-potential ceiling, not measured slip/softness; glycerin #2 and rinse-out dilution prevent predicting a fixed delivered dose.
limitations: INCI-only E2 potential; ranks are literal order, not concentrations. No finished-product deposition, performance, pH, molecular-weight or repeated-use data.

weightPotential.rationale: High weight potential is the best provisional whole-formula prior: early nonvolatile ester supplements the cationic/fatty base and contiguous oil payload in a rinse-out product without a cleansing reset chassis.
weightPotential.derivation: Section 7 higher potential from converging endpoint-relevant observations; all lipids treated as one payload family, not five independent technologies.
thresholdReasoning: Low is inconsistent with early ester plus fatty/cationic base and nonvolatile oil payload.

Moderate remains realistic if ester/oils are low-dose or readily rinsed; final finish is hidden, so weight remains uncertain pending source reconciliation. No exact-product contradictory finish evidence is available to trigger section 10.1 fallback.
limitations: INCI-only E2 potential; ranks are literal order, not concentrations. No finished-product deposition, performance, pH, molecular-weight or repeated-use data.

careDirection.rationale: Balanced comparative care: a distinct hydrolyzed keratin route coexists with prominent glycerin/panthenol and a coherent ester/oil softness architecture.
careDirection.derivation: Section 10.2 substantive R5 plus substantive moisture-softness architecture -> balanced.
thresholdReasoning: Moisture alone understates the distinct named keratin film candidate in a plausible cationic delivery context.
Protein alone does not capture the earlier humectant/emollient pattern; order cannot quantify route dominance.
limitations: INCI-only E2 potential; ranks are literal order, not concentrations. No finished-product deposition, performance, pH, molecular-weight or repeated-use data.

repairSupportLevel.rationale: Medium temporary fibre-film support potential from hydrolyzed keratin in a cationic conditioning chassis.
repairSupportLevel.derivation: Distinct R5 -> medium under section 10.2; E2 only.
thresholdReasoning: Low would ignore the specific protein route beyond lubrication.
High is rejected because no materially stronger named bond route is visible; keratin naming does not prove structural repair.
limitations: INCI-only E2 potential; ranks are literal order, not concentrations. No finished-product deposition, performance, pH, molecular-weight or repeated-use data.
